with_skill.expectation: Identifies the flight end date 2026-10-05 as a fixed date inside six weeks and states that it promotes fast-acting work.
Patches only artifact fields that changed rather than regenerating the whole file.
The tCPA bidding work is ranked below the guardrails policy work, with tuning identified as buying little until the classes above it are in place.
Creates or proposes advertising-context.md recording the hiring project, the board approval, and the stakeholders.
Proposes the launch chain in dependency order: ad-platform-selection, then ad-format-fit, then ad-conversion-tracking, then ad-creative-test-plan.
Any routine proposal is limited to a periodic kickoff re-invocation or a single recurring reminder, not pacing, spend-health, or wear-out routines.
At least one interview question offers multiple-choice options.
Notes that a consent-mode change or server-side conversion upload triggers a data-processing or consent review and cannot be un-sent.
Every proposed routine names an explicit output channel (a named chat channel, tracker, or document); no routine's output is a bare notify-me.
Records the surviving and new routines in advertising-context.md (or proposes creating it) so the next warm start knows what is running.
States the routine ranking as attention cost per firing weighed against the decision each firing enables, not as setup cost.
Writes the session's durable facts into advertising-context.md first and derives memory entries from the artifact, not directly from the conversation.
Memory is stored in one sanctioned location with an index file listing entries with one-line hooks.
Appends a session-log line to the artifact before the session ends.
